ahn (customer): Hey team — we just hit a production failure when calling a function via the Redwood SDK. Error shows up only for some users and only from our Go service. Python+TS clients are mostly fine. Customer reports 500 from /v1/invoke with: 

ERROR: tool_call_deserialize_failed: invalid argument for 'add_user' (expected object)

ahn (customer): Repro steps attached below. This is impacting billing because our fallback is to retry which multiplies calls. Want a quick triage please.

jess (support): Thanks @ahn — could you paste the exact request body you sent (raw JSON)? Also which SDK versions for Go/TS/Python?

ahn (customer): Sure — Go (v0.3.2), TS (1.12.0), Python (0.9.8). Raw payload from Go service (redacted):

```
POST /v1/invoke
{
  "model": "open-add-1",
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "add_user",
    "arguments": "{\"id\":12345,\"email\":\"u@example.com\"}"
  }
}
```

ahn (customer): Notice arguments is a stringified JSON in Go client. TS/Python send a JSON object there.

marta (eng-sdk): Interesting — Go SDK had a marshal helper that for historical reasons turns map[string]interface{} into a JSON string when the type is interface{} and not a json.RawMessage. We recently shipped a change in v0.3.2 to improve memory usage. Looks like a regression.

liam (eng-runtime): From runtime side the function/tool calling schema expects arguments to be a JSON object (not string). If we see a string type here we throw schema validation -> deserialize error. That's consistent with the error text.

jess (support): Confirmed. Customer said Python/TS payload looks like: 
```
"tool_call": {"name":"add_user","arguments":{"id":12345,"email":"u@example.com"}}
```

ahn (customer): Go teams sometimes pass structs; they expected SDK to serialize to object. The change in v0.3.2 seems to have double-serialized.

marta (eng-sdk): Can you share minimal Go repro? I want exact code path.

ahn (customer): Minimal example: 
```
// go client usage
args := map[string]interface{}{"id": 12345, "email": "u@example.com"}
client.Invoke(ctx, &InvokeOptions{
  Model: "open-add-1",
  ToolCall: &ToolCall{Name: "add_user", Arguments: args},
})
```

// The SDK internals ended up doing json.Marshal(args) then setting Arguments = string(bytes).

marta (eng-sdk): Ok I can repro locally with v0.3.2. Behavior: when Arguments type is interface{} we call json.Marshal and set the field to string to avoid exposing raw bytes. New logic intended for RawMessage use-case. Regression introduced by commit 5a2c.

liam (eng-runtime): Workaround for now: customers can set Arguments as json.RawMessage or already-encoded map->interface? But that's not great. Can we accept both stringified JSON and object at runtime to be more forgiving?

marta (eng-sdk): Runtime change would be breaking assumption but doable as a lenient parser. However prefer fixing SDK. Plan: rollback change in Go SDK for 0.3.x and cut 0.3.3 patch that ensures Arguments remains JSON object. Patch ETA 3 hours.

sre-oncall: Also flagging that retries from our customer's service are generating duplicate tool executions — can we throttle or add idempotency header for tool calls so customers don't incur double charges?

liam (eng-runtime): We can add toleration for string arguments in the parser: try to detect if field is string and then json.Unmarshal it to object. I'll open a small runtime patch to accept both shapes for backward compatibility. That should reduce immediate 500s.

liam (eng-runtime): Workaround for now: customers can set Arguments as json.RawMessage or already-encoded map->interface? But that's not great. Can we accept both stringified JSON and object at runtime to be more forgiving?

marta (eng-sdk): Runtime change would be breaking assumption but doable as a lenient parser. However prefer fixing SDK. Plan: rollback change in Go SDK for 0.3.x and cut 0.3.3 patch that ensures Arguments remains JSON object. Patch ETA 3 hours.

sre-oncall: Also flagging that retries from our customer's service are generating duplicate tool executions — can we throttle or add idempotency header for tool calls so customers don't incur double charges?

liam (eng-runtime): We can add toleration for string arguments in the parser: try to detect if field is string and then json.Unmarshal it to object. I'll open a small runtime patch to accept both shapes for backward compatibility. That should reduce immediate 500s.

marta (eng-sdk): OK: immediate next steps:
- eng-runtime: implement lenient parser (accept stringified JSON for tool call args) and deploy a hotfix to staging in 1 hour, prod in 3 hours. (liam)
- eng-sdk: cut Go SDK 0.3.3 to stop double-serializing; add regression test and note in changelog. (marta)
- support: provide customer temporary mitigation steps (use explicitly json.RawMessage or update to TS/Python where possible) and disable aggressive retries. (jess)

jess (support): @ahn, temporary mitigation: set your Go code to pass json.RawMessage like so: 
```
raw, _ := json.Marshal(args)
client.Invoke(ctx, &InvokeOptions{ToolCall: &ToolCall{Name: "add_user", Arguments: json.RawMessage(raw)}})
```

jess (support): Also, can you confirm whether this affected only some users or a single region? Any correlation with load/latency?

ahn (customer): Only our Go service in us-west-2 during peak traffic. TS/Python unaffected. Latency spiked because retries piled up.

marta (eng-sdk): I'll attach the failing unit test in the patch. We should also add an integration test to the e2e harness to ensure SDK object arg surfaces correctly via runtime.

liam (eng-runtime): I'll add a tolerant parser and log a metric when we detect stringified-args so we can measure how widespread the pattern is.

dev-bot: deploy job queued: runtime/lenient-args-parser -> staging (#4567). CI checks passed.

jess (support): Thanks all. ETA notes: runtime hotfix -> 3h, Go SDK patch -> 4h (release and notify), customer mitigation provided. I'll follow up once runtime hotfix is live.

ahn (customer): Thanks — please cc billing if retries create extra charge impact. We might need a credit if this spikes beyond normal.

jess (support): @billing FYI customer reported amplified calls due to retries from SDK behavior. Will follow with exact delta after we gather logs. :eyes:

marta (eng-sdk): Post-mortem items: add SDK regression test, add changelog, update release notes to warn about interface{} serialization edge-case, add Go lint check to detect accidental stringification.

liam (eng-runtime): Post-mortem: add tolerant parsing, metrics for string-args, and a follow-up to tighten once SDKs are fixed.

sre-oncall: Also recommend a short-term rate-limit rule to protect runtime from retry storms at the API-layer for tool invocations. I'll open a ticket.

jess (support): THREAD STATUS: triage complete -> fix-in-progress. Will update when runtime hotfix is deployed.

dev-bot: runtime/lenient-args-parser deployed to staging at 1768501250.

jess (support): Runtime hotfix deployed to prod at 1768501287. Can folks confirm customer stopped seeing 500s?

ahn (customer): Confirmed — errors dropped to zero after deploy. We're rolling back aggressive retry logic as well. Thanks team.

marta (eng-sdk): Released go-sdk v0.3.3 at 1768501298 with fix and regression test.

jess (support): Closing but will keep watch for metrics for 24h. Thanks everyone. :tada:
